comment: Individuals should be able to identify who accessed their record, but raw technical audit logs may be confusing, incomplete, or reveal protected information about professionals and investigations.

citation.raw: §Lifelong Health Record, Governance p.165 l.Governance item 3

public.text: Individuals should be able to identify who accessed their record, but raw technical audit logs may be confusing, incomplete, or reveal protected information about professionals and investigations.
public.suggestedRevision: Provide understandable access-history views with date, organisation, purpose, action, and support for challenge, subject to proportionate security and legal exceptions.
